items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Caribou' as a name, but the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or recognition of this individual.

ctx.x: All right, let's see. I think it's going now. Today is September what? Third. Today is September the third, and we're recording today at 1926 Harmony Street. And this is your home. Let's get your name, too. Caribou. And your name?
You said they paraded in the streets huh?
